message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
My goal is to find a common 30-minute meeting slot for all four partners next week. My colleague, Alison, has already provided the available slots for two of the partners, Priya and Marcus. My task is to check these proposed times against the calendars of the other two partners, Elena and David, whose calendars I have access to.

First, I will retrieve the calendar for Elena Soto to see her availability. Then, I will do the same for David Okafor. Once I have both of their schedules, I can cross-reference them with the times Alison suggested. After identifying a suitable time, I will communicate this back to Alison through our shared workspace so she can proceed with booking the meeting. Finally, I will end my session. This approach will take a total of four actions.
